responsibility: Declares the built-in `SIZE` pseudo-function symbol for the gm2 front end and the routine that creates it. This module’s responsibility is narrowly to expose and initialize the pervasive `SIZE` function entity so later semantic and quad-building code can recognize and special-case it.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for the M2Size pair: it merely exports the global symbol handle `Size` and the `MakeSize` entry point. Unlike `M2Size.mod`, it does not create the built-in procedure symbol, assign its return type, or reinsert it into later module scopes.
